d4_intro_1.speaker: Narration
d4_intro_1.text: A waiting room that smells of tea and old paper. A new name on the door — someone who, the leaflet says, works with people like them.

d4_intro_2.speaker: Narration
d4_intro_2.text: No one is in trouble here. No line to hold, no crisis to fix. Only a quiet question: who wants to speak, and be heard?

d4_intro_3.speaker: Narration
d4_intro_3.text: The door opens. Who steps in first?

d4_out_june.speaker: June
d4_out_june.text: She speaks softly, for all of them. "There's more than one of us. We're learning to listen to each other." The therapist only nods, unsurprised, and something inside unclenches.

d4_out_iris.speaker: Iris
d4_out_iris.text: Measured, careful, watching for danger that doesn't come. The words are honest, if guarded — and being believed is its own small relief.

d4_out_rowan.speaker: Rowan
d4_out_rowan.text: He arrives with a plan and a list of goals, eager to fix what isn't broken. Slowly he notices: no one is grading this. He sits back, just a little.

d4_done.speaker: Narration
d4_done.text: They step back into the street, lighter somehow. Being known — really known — turns out not to be the danger they once learned it was.
